components.note: 角 (horn) — an ox's horn; with 刀 (knife) the picture is cutting up an ox, so "to take apart", then to loosen and explain.
刀 (knife) — cutting, as in 分, 切, 到; a blade separates the parts.
纟 (silk thread, simplified 糸) — threads and ties, as in 红, 给, 经; 结 is a knot.
吉 (jí) is a close sound clue for jié; 吉 also sounds out 洁 jié.
束 (bind) — a 木 tied around with a cord 口: a bundle of wood. 束 also gives 速 sù (hurried) and 嗽 sòu.
公 (public) — 八 over 厶: dividing 八 what is private 厶; so "shared, public, fair".
司 (sī) is a sound clue for 词 cí and 饲 sì; as a word it means to manage, as in 公司 company.
成 (chéng) is a sound clue for 城 chéng, 诚 chéng and 盛 chéng: the same sound.
水 (water) — water and flow: 永 first meant a long river. 泳 yǒng (swimming) added the water radical later.
辶 (walk) — movement and distance, as in 过, 近, 进: 远 is a road that goes far.
元 (yuán) is a close sound clue for yuǎn; 元 also in 完 wán and 院 yuàn.
巾 (cloth) — cloth, as in 布, 带, 帽: 帮 first meant the side of a shoe.
邦 (bāng, nation) gives the exact sound; 邦 itself means state or country.
力 (strength) — effort, as in 办, 男, 努; 助 is to lend strength.
且 (qiě) is a loose sound clue for zhù; 且 also sounds out 祖 zǔ, 租 zū and 姐 jiě.
讠 (speech) — words and language, as in 请, 谢, 话.
兑 (duì) is a loose sound clue for shuō; 兑 also sounds out 脱 tuō, 税 shuì and 悦 yuè.
小 (small) — a 小 with a stroke taken off: not much. 少 also gives sound to 沙 shā, 抄 chāo and 炒 chǎo.
它 (it) — an old picture of a snake; 蛇 shé (snake) adds 虫. Its pronoun use is borrowed. Sound series: 拖 tuō, 驼 tuó.
石 (stone) — stone and hardness, as in 碎 shatter, 破 break, 码 code: 确 is solid, certain.
角 (jiǎo) replaces 隺 (hè) of 確 and is only a loose clue for què.
氵 (water) — water and liquids, as in 河, 海, 汤: clear water.
青 (qīng) gives the exact sound; also 请 qǐng, 情 qíng, 晴 qíng and 精 jīng.
宀 (roof) — houses and shelter, as in 家, 字, 室.
女 (woman) — a woman at home under the roof: calm and safe.
心 (heart) — wishes and feelings, as in 想, 思, 感: 愿 is what the heart wants.
原 (yuán) is a close sound clue for yuàn; 原 also in 源 yuán.
刂 (knife) — cutting, as in 到, 分, 别: 划 is to cut a line, then to plan (计划) or row (huá).
女 (woman) — women and family, as in 妈, 好, 姐; 她 is the female "she", coined to parallel 他.
也 (yě) is only a loose sound clue for tā; the 他 pair is the same part.
讠 (speech) — words and language, as in 说, 请, 话.
炎 (yán) is a close sound clue for tán; 炎 also sounds out 淡 dàn and 痰 tán.
灬 (fire) — fire and heat, as in 热 hot, 点 dot, 黑 black: light shining.
昭 (zhāo) is a close sound clue for zhào; 昭 itself means bright.
片 (slice) — the right half of 木 split down the middle: a flat piece. See 版 bǎn (printing plate) and 牌 pái (card).
母 (mǔ) is a close sound clue for měi; the same part also in 海 hǎi, 梅 méi and 悔 huǐ.
辶 (walk) — movement, as in 过, 近, 送: to go toward someone.
卬 (áng) is a loose sound clue for yíng; 卬 also in 仰 yǎng.
儿 (person, legs) — with 口 mouth on top: the elder brother who speaks for the family. 兄 also in 况 kuàng.
弟 (dì) is a sound clue for 第 dì, 梯 tī and 剃 tì; as a word it means younger brother.
人 (person) — one person following another: 从 means to follow, then "from".
心 (heart) — mind and feelings, as in 想, 思, 感: 总 is simplified from 總, whose threads gathered everything together.
手 (hand) — two hands joined in respect: bowing and saluting; compare 扌 in 拿 and 打.
扌 (hand) — hand actions, as in 打, 拿, 抱: 托 is to hold up with the hand.
乇 (tuō) gives the exact sound.
女 (woman) — women and family, as in 妈, 她, 好.
且 (qiě) is a loose sound clue for jiě; 且 also sounds out 祖 zǔ, 租 zū and 助 zhù.
氵 (water) — water and flow, as in 河, 海, 清: water draining away.
肖 (xiāo) gives the exact sound; also in 销 xiāo and 削 xuē.
自 (nose) — over 心 heart: breath comes through the nose from the heart, so rest, news.
此 (cǐ) is a sound clue for 紫 zǐ, 雌 cí and 些 xiē; as a word it means "this".
氵 (water) — water, as in 河, 海, 清: in the old form 灋, water stood for fairness, so law and method.
户 (door) — doors and houses, as in 所 and 扇: a room with a door.
方 (fāng) is a close sound clue for fáng; 方 also sounds out 放 fàng and 访 fǎng.
衣 (clothes) — a picture of a coat with a collar and sleeves. As a radical it is 衤 on the left: 裤 trousers, 衬 shirt, 被 quilt.
口 (mouth) — sound and speech, as in 吃, 唱, 问.
斤 (jīn, axe) is only a loose clue for tīng; the traditional 聽 had 耳 ear.
参 (cān) is a sound clue for 惨 cǎn and 掺 chān; the old shape pictured three stars.
力 (strength) — with 口 mouth: adding strength by words, hence to add, to increase. 加 also in 架 jià and 驾 jià.
力 (strength) — effort, as in 助, 男, 努: handling things takes effort. The two dots stand in for 辡 of the traditional 辦.
口 (mouth) — speech and sound, as in 吃, 唱, 问: 唯 first meant a quick reply, yes.
隹 (zhuī, short-tailed bird) is a close sound clue for wéi; 隹 also in 维 wéi and 惟 wéi.
歹 (bad bone) — death and decay, as in 残 remnant, 烈 fierce, 殊 special.
匕 (person) — a person beside bones: death.
辶 (walk) — movement, as in 过, 近, 进: to go and pick.
先 (xiān) is a close sound clue for xuǎn; 先 also in 洗 xǐ.
扌 (hand) — hand actions, as in 打, 拿, 抱: picking out with the hand.
圣 stands in for 睪 of 擇, a loose sound clue for zé; the original shows up in 泽 zé.
厂 (cliff) — cliffs and rocks, as in 厅 hall, 厚 thick: a spring flowing from a cliff.
泉 (spring) — water from the rock: the source (源 yuán adds 氵 later); 原 is source, origin.
宀 (roof) — houses and shelter, as in 家, 字, 室: a house stocked with goods, so solid and real.
